title: 类的属性
problem_statement_md:
假设你是一家酒店的管理员，需要为每个新顾客编写信息卡。
在卡片上，你必须注明客人的姓氏、名子、年龄和房间号。

给定程序将客人的数据（姓氏、名字、年龄和房间号）作为输入。
通过添加相应的属性来完成客户类`Customer`，以便`saveCustomerInfo()`方法能够正常工作。同时将数据赋值给所创建对象的属性。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Class Attributes[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are the administrator of a hotel and must create customer information cards for your new customers. On the card, you must note the customer’s first and last name, age, and room number. 
The program you are given takes a guest's data (first name, last name, age, and room number) as input.
Complete the class by adding corresponding attributes so that the saveCustomerInfo() method works correctly. Also assign taken data values to attributes of created object.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
John
Smith
35
204

[b]Sample Output[/b]
First name: John
Second name: Smith
Age: 35
Room number: 204

[note]Be attentive to set [b]correct data types[/b] for attributes.[/note]
hint_md: 要注意为属性设置**正确的数据类型**。

testcases.expected_output:
First name: John
Second name: Smith
Age: 35
Room number: 204
